profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I enjoy making myself indispensable in any organization.  My joy and capacity is in providing technical leadership and mentoring, while delivering compelling solutions that delight customers.  I prefer managing a small team of cracker-jack developers to deliver core differentiating technology.  This may be used directly by customers, or in support of other in-house development teams.  I delight in customer interactions – soliciting feedback, presenting at user conferences, etc.  I find great challenge and satisfaction in using my communication skills to demystify technology, translating it into the customer’s domain.  I’m accustomed to wearing many hats, being involved in all aspects of product development.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description: Internally, responsibility for technology selection, standardization, and strategy; and for executive-level briefings of business relevance of same.  Responsibility for interviewing, hiring, and mentoring of development staff, including instituting peer reviews, documenting best practices, and attending conferences.  Care and feeding of all company IP - development tools and infrastructure, license compliance, patent research, competitive analyses, etc.  Lead initiatives for increasing application performance and development process efficiency.  Externally, liaison for partners and customers.  Presenter at several user conferences and customer engagements.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Chief software architect for new application development.  Partnered with VP of Sales for pre-sales engagements with prospective clients. Served as primary technical liaison for customers and partners.  Created general 3-tier architecture for design/configuration software that was leveraged for several clients.  Key areas of innovation included:
•	Creating a unified architecture enabling simultaneous release of desktop and online editions of design software.
•	Replacing a proprietary parametric model database with an off-the-shelf RDBMS implementation (MS SQL Server), and complementary visual editing tool.
•	Replacing a proprietary XML-based product catalog and bill-of-materials views with DHTML-based implementations, affording a richer user experience, easing the data maintenance burden, and supporting XSLT-based file export conversions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Implementation of key systems and processes in company's flagship product, a proprietary 3D space-planning configuration tool, including:  Print, Compound File I/O, File Import/Export, Crash Handling and Reporting, Bill of Materials, Online Help, Automated Build Process, Release Process.  Developed prototypes for prospective clients and supported business development initiatives.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Provided feasibility study for a potential new product.  Research included competitive market analysis, cost/benefit analyses for different implementation options, and other technical evaluations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Principal or lead developer on several projects, including an offline browser product, and a distributed, enterprise-class internet packet filtering and reporting tool.  Various development leadership roles and responsibilities, including: software tool research, purchase, and training; authoring automated build environments; creation of cross-platform frameworks; point of contact for several partners; mentoring for other developers.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Member of elite "new technology group", creating foundation for next generation of company's terminal emulation software suite.  Worked at forefront of technologies new to the company, such as OLE, Win32, and C++.  Prior to that, had responsibility for major components of a legacy product (file transfer, serialization, graphics engine), and made several high-profile customer visits.  As a rookie, led an initiative to reduce the sustaining team's longstanding bug count to zero.  Created various internal tools to optimize development process (WinHelp, PVCS, etc).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in major 2-tier application re-architecture, from DOS to Windows platform, using C and Visual BASIC.  Took initiative in learning C to communicate programmatically with MS SQL Server (via embedded SQL), and company mainframes (via HLLAPI and LU6.2 techniques).  Project lead for sustaining networked Turbo Pascal database application.  Responsible for I/O subsystem on distributed Turbo Pascal database application.  Authored various distributed databases and utilities in C, Turbo Pascal and Paradox, using SQL Server and LAN Manager APIs.  Received several commendations, including Boeing's "Pride In Excellence" award.

positions.title: E.E. College Internship
positions.description: Authored laboratory analysis software, including gauge calibration and soil test automation programs.  Designed and constructed small-signal amplifiers and a 64 to 16 channel analog multiplexer module for use with a DT 2801 ADC board.
